stops.name: Sierra de Francia
stops.detail: The Sierra de Francia is a mountain range located in Sierra de Francia Comarca at the southern end of Salamanca Province, Castile and León, Spain. It is located about 70 km from Salamanca city.  The region is sparsely inhabited and its few towns have great cultural value.
